subject.title: fix(matrix): tolerate SAS accept events missing method

question: Should OpenClaw accept a Matrix plugin wrapper around matrix-js-sdk's private `cryptoBackend.preprocessToDeviceMessages` boundary for this Element SAS compatibility case once live proof is added?
rationale: The code path is the right pre-Rust boundary for the reported failure, but it is private dependency surface and touches Matrix E2EE verification preprocessing, so automation should not silently turn that into a permanent compatibility contract.

options.title: Require Live Proof, Then Accept Hook
options.body: Add redacted Element/Synapse after-fix proof from this branch, then merge if maintainers are comfortable carrying the private SDK recheck on future matrix-js-sdk upgrades.

options.title: Pause For Upstream Or Public API
options.body: Hold this PR and pursue a matrix-js-sdk or Element-side fix if maintainers do not want OpenClaw to depend on the private `cryptoBackend` shape.

options.title: Override Proof And Own Risk
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly override the proof gate and accept the private-hook risk based on the reporter's local hotfix evidence plus tests.

recommendation.title: Require Live Proof, Then Accept Hook
recommendation.body: Add redacted Element/Synapse after-fix proof from this branch, then merge if maintainers are comfortable carrying the private SDK recheck on future matrix-js-sdk upgrades.
